follow-up time: Until June 2016 (from recruitment between January 1, 2014 and December 31, 2014)
exposure: Time of diagnosis (early postpartum vs. antepartum or late postpartum)
cohort: 4 females diagnosed with peripartum cardiomyopathy (PPCM) between January 1, 2014 and December 31, 2014 at Salmaniya Medical Complex, Bahrain.
finding: Myocardial recovery in PPCM may be related to early postpartum diagnosis, suggesting that early diagnosis and treatment may improve outcomes.
